preconditions.description: The number of pairs n is between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(w_odd_even) == n and all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in w_odd_even)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n weights for edges connecting odd vertices to their corresponding even vertices, each between 1 and 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(tree_edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w1 <= 10**12 and 1 <= w2 <= 10**12 for x, y, w1, w2 in tree_edges)
preconditions.description: There are n-1 lines describing tree edges, where x and y are distinct indices in [1, n], and weights w1, w2 are valid positive integers up to 10^12.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 600,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 2*n and 1 <= v <= 2*n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct vertices u and v within the range [1, 2n].

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == shortest_path_distance(queries[i][0], queries[i][1], n, w_odd_even, tree_edges) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th output line is the integer representing the length of the shortest path between vertices u_i and v_i in the described graph.
